pick.name: Apollo.io database + NPPES NPI Registry
pick.what: Apollo for enterprise contacts; the US government NPI registry (free API) for healthcare organisations/providers by specialty and location
pick.why: Both cost nothing extra: Apollo is owned, NPPES is public data that pinpoints US healthcare targets Apollo covers thinly
pick.free_limits: NPPES API free (rate/size limits not shown on page)

alts.name: Clay
alts.why: Best for enriching NPI or account lists with many providers; free 500 actions + 100 data credits/mo

alts.why: For buying-committee mapping at named accounts

candidates.name: Clay
candidates.verdict: Enrichment layer when lists need many sources

candidates.verdict: Best healthcare data but enterprise-priced (not checked)

decision: Build healthcare target lists from NPPES (organisation NPIs + taxonomy), enrich decision-makers in Apollo, and use Clay only when match rates are poor.
